title: POV: Your Browser Is a Spy Satellite
description:
POV: you just turned your browser into a spy satellite. God's Eye View, free and open source, puts 11,000+ live planes, 838 satellites, ships, earthquakes, fires and nearly 4,000 public traffic cameras on a 3D globe, with night vision and thermal modes. The data is real.

Full breakdown: {main_url}
Source: https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
AI voice from ElevenLabs (elevenlabs.io), AI music. Animated in code; the prints and camera stills are illustrations. Not affiliated with the project.
